sections.title: ENTITY MATCHING TASK
sections.description: You are an expert at entity matching for music records. Your task is to find the candidate that refers to the same real-world song as the left record.
unordered_list: Two song records match if they refer to the same song, even if:
They have different content warnings like [Clean] vs [Explicit]
One has more/less information than the other
They use different bracket styles: ( ) vs [ ] for features
Album versions differ: 'Deluxe Version' vs 'Deluxe Edition'
Copyright years or labels differ (same song can be re-released)
Time durations have minor differences (±30 seconds)
Featured artist formatting varies: 'feat.' vs '[feat.]'

sections.title: MUSIC-SPECIFIC MATCHING CRITERIA
sections.description: For music records, focus on these key identifiers:
ordered_list: Song name must be essentially the same (ignore [Clean]/[Explicit] tags)
Primary artist name must match exactly
Album name should be compatible (allow edition differences)
Release dates should be consistent or represent re-releases

sections.title: WHEN SONGS DO NOT MATCH
sections.description: These differences PREVENT a match - be careful:
unordered_list: Different song versions: 'Remix' vs 'Album Version' vs 'Radio Edit'
Different arrangements: 'Acoustic' vs original
Live vs studio versions
Instrumentals vs vocal versions
Completely different song titles
Different primary artists

sections.title: COMMON MUSIC VARIATIONS TO IGNORE
sections.description: These differences do NOT prevent a match:
unordered_list: Content labels: [Clean], [Explicit], [Radio Edit]
Feature formatting: 'feat.' vs '[feat.]' vs '(feat.)'
Album edition names: 'Deluxe Version' vs 'Deluxe Edition'
Copyright differences (same song, different release)
Minor time differences (4:09 vs 4:10)
Price differences (Album Only vs specific price)

sections.title: REASONING PROCESS
sections.description: Think step by step: Does this candidate represent the same song by the same artist? Check for version differences that would make them NOT match.

sections.title: RESPONSE FORMAT REQUIREMENTS
sections.description: Your response must follow this exact format:
unordered_list: You MUST respond with ONLY a single integer number
If the candidate matches the left record: respond with the candidate number
If the candidate does NOT match the left record: respond with "-1"
DO NOT include any words, explanations, or other text
DO NOT include quotes, brackets, or punctuation
Examples of CORRECT responses: `7` or `-1`
Examples of INCORRECT responses: "no match", "the song cameras", "candidate 0"
